spans.s: (wrongly written प्र-णष्ट, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 36, Sch.) lost, disappeared, vanished, ceased, gone, perished, destroyed, annihilated, Mn.; MBh. &c.
See प्र-णश्, p. 659.
प्र-नष्ट—ज्ञानिक mfn. one whose knowledge or memory is destroyed, Suśr.
प्र-नष्ट—विनय mfn. uncivil, rude, MW.
प्र-नष्ट—स्वामिक mfn. (property) the owner of which has disappeared, Mn. viii, 30.
lost and found again, ib., 33.
प्र-˚णिंसितव्य or प्र-निंसितव्य, mfn. to be kissed, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 33.
प्र-˚णिक्षण or प्र-निक्षण, n., Pāṇ. viii, 4, 33, Sch.
= -णिक्षण, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 33, Sch.
प्र-˚णिन्दन or प्र-नि˚न्दन, n. censuring, upbraiding, Pāṇ.; ib., Sch.
= -णिन्दन, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 33, Sch.
प्र-√ नक्ष् P. Ā. -नक्षति, ˚ते, to draw near, approach, RV. vii, 42, 1.
a great grandson, Uṇ., Sch.
प्र-√ नभ् Ā. -नभते, to burst asunder, open, AV.
प्र-√ नर्द् P. -नर्दति, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 14, Sch.
प्र-˚नर्दक mfn., ib.
one whose leader is away, whose rulers are abroad
destitute of a guide, Pāṇ. i, 4, 59; viii, 4, 14, Sch.
w.r. for -णाशिन्, q.v.
-निंसितव्य = -णिंसित, -णिंसितव्य, q.v.
killing, slaughter, murder, L.
प्र-नि-√ भिद् P. -भिनत्ति, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 18, Sch.
प्र-नि-√ रक्ष् P. -रक्षति, Vop.
w.r. for प्र-डीन, (q.v.), MBh. xii, 9314.
w.r. for -णुद् (q.v.), Suśr.
प्र-˚नर्तित mfn. caused to d˚ forwards, set in motion, shaken, agitated
dandled, MW.
प्र-˚नृत्त mfn. one who has begun to d˚, dancing, MBh.; R.; Kathās.
प्र-˚नृत्त n. a dance, MārkP.
प्र-˚नृत्त—वत् mfn. having begun to d˚, MBh.; Kathās.
प्र-˚नृत्य mfn. or n. w.r. for ˚नृत्त.
प्र-˚नृत्य-वत् w.r. for ˚नृत्त-वत्.
प्रा—नाडी f. = (or w.r. for) प्र-णाडी = प्र-णाली, MBh.
See under 3. प्रा, p. 702.
(said to be fr. प्र + अंशु) high, tall, long, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
strong, intense, Naiṣ.
N. of a son of Manu Vaivasvata, Hariv.; Pur.
of a son of Vatsa-prī (or -prīti), Pur.
प्रांशु—ता f. height, loftiness, R.
प्रांशु—प्राकार mfn. having long walls, Kathās.
प्रांशु—लभ्य mfn. to be obtained or reached (only) by a tall person, Ragh.
large, big (said of an animal), HYog.
See प्राण्, p. 705, col. 1.
touching the organs of sense of sense, Gaut.
pl. N. of a people, Baudh.
n. (प्र-अन्त) (ifc. f(आ). ) edge, border, margin, verge, extremity, end, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (यौवन-प्र्˚, the end of youth, Pañcat.; ओष्ठ-प्रान्तौ, the corners of the mouth, L.)
a point, tip (of a blade of grass), Kauś.
back part (of a carriage), Vikr. (ibc., finally, eventually, Kāv.; Pañcat.)
thread end of a cloth, L.
N. of a man g. अश्वादि
dwelling near the boundaries, Divyāv.
प्रान्त—ग mfn. living close by, L.
प्रान्त—चर mfn. id. (ifc.), MārkP.
प्रान्त—तस् ind. along the edge or border (of anything), marginally, L.
प्रान्त—दुर्ग n. ‘border-stronghold’, a suburb or collection of houses outside the walls of a town, L.
प्रान्त—निवासिन् mfn. dwelling near the boundaries, MBh.
प्रान्त—पुष्पा f. a kind of plant, L.
प्रान्त—भूमि f. final place or term
प्रान्त—भूमौ ind. finally, at last (others ‘up to the verge of the border’), Yogas.
प्रान्त—विरस mfn. tasteless in the end, Pañcat.
प्रान्त—वृति f. ‘end-circle’, the horizon, Mālatīm.
प्रान्त—शयनासन-भक्त mfn. Living in the country (also -शयन-भक्त and -शयनासना-सेविन्), Divyāv.
प्रान्त—स्थ mfn. inhabiting the borders, MW.
patr. fr. प्रान्त, g. अश्वादि.
a long desolate road, MārkP.; Hit.
the country intervening between two villages, L.
a forest, L.
the hollow of a tree, L.
प्रान्तर—शून्य n. a long dreary road, W.
